violation_type.title: Food Service and Preparation Requirement - Safe and Sanitary (26 TAC §744.2419)
violation_type.short_title: Food Service and Preparation Requirement - Safe and Sanitary
violation_type.typical_finding: Tables were used for playing with toys in centers when children arrived.  Tables were not sanitized after toys were removed and children were served snack.

finding_variants.text: Tables were used for playing with toys in centers when children arrived.  Tables were not sanitized after toys were removed and children were served snack.
A child was observed preparing snack for other children without washing hands after touching cleaning supplies.

The classrooms were all observed to have milk and juice cartons left out from am. snack which is served from 07:00 and to 08:30 am. The food items were observed out on the counter past 10:30 am. All of the left out drinks and food items were discarded during the inspection.
